headline: SpaceX catches Starship upper stage with tower for first time
summary: SpaceX successfully caught the Starship upper stage with its launch and catch tower for the first time, after previously performing similar "chopstick" catches only on its Super Heavy boosters. During this flight, SpaceX had aborted a planned catch of the booster before the tower successfully captured the Starship vehicle itself.
